details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Stone sculptures stand where no human road reaches.

**Purpose:** Protect a home and the stories carved into its walls.

**Tactics and retreat:** Throw from high ground, then use a broad staff sweep when approached.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Speak before entering the carved boundary and avoid damaging the art.

**Habitat:** Mountain; cavern · **Communication:** Giant and Common

**Loot:** A carved stone commission or 80 coins of trade goods.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-stone-giant


**Category:** Giant · **Role:** Artillery brute · **CV:** 37

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Thrown boulder | Brawn | 1 Boon | 5 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. Push 1. | 10 physical damage. Push 2. |
| Stone staff | Brawn | 1 Boon | 4 physical damage. | 6 physical damage. | 8 physical damage. |
| Clearing shove | Brawn | 1 Boon | 2 physical damage; push 2. | 4 physical damage; push 4. | 6 physical damage; push 5. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** A slow or broad exposed body gives the attacker a Boon. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 5/7/10

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.4

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.25 → 1.4: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.596, O=6.951. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [Bat Aside the Missile](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/bat-aside-the-missile.md), [Plant the Weight](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/brace-ground.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [sweeping attack](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/sweeping-attack.md).

# Bat Aside the Missile

*A broad hand or haft meets the incoming missile with the ease of brushing a branch aside.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-bat-aside-the-missile

**Action:** Reaction

Before one physical ranged attack from a visible attacker against this creature is rolled, impose 1 Bane on that attack. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to its defense instead. No protection against area attacks; no missile is returned and the attack still resolves.
